dialect: Standard Mandarin (Putonghua, mainland norm), Simplified characters

profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA with Chao tone letters (broad, Putonghua); spoken = pinyin with tone marks
profile.grammar_notes: No tense; aspect via 了/过/着 and 在/正在. 是 for identity, 有 for existence/possession, 在 for location. Measure words are a closed set per noun. Questions with 吗, A-not-A, question words in situ. Negation 不 vs 没(有). Modal set 想/要/会/能/可以/应该/得. Topic-comment structure; resultative and directional complements; 把 and 被 constructions; 的/地/得 structural particles; sentence-final particles 了/吧/呢/啊. Politeness is lexical (您, 请, 麻烦), not grammatical. At B2 the blockers are: complements (resultative/potential/degree), 把/被 handling, connector pairs (虽然…但是, 既然, 就/才 timing), register-sensitive discourse markers, and near-synonym traps.
